title: 第十三章 流沙古渡 河豚妖兴浪覆舟第十四章 荒庙夜雨 鬼母摄魂 群煞罹难
content_zh:
辞阴墟鬼市，破山精幻局，四神离荒谷复向西行。
自下凡历劫以来，斩白骨、祈甘霖、屠蛇魅、度羊妖、破鬼市，五难已过。宁洋北青龙生机浩荡，王学南玄武镇御沉稳，张忠东朱雀烈火刚烈，陈学西白虎杀伐凛冽。四象神力愈加交感相融，行路之间，灵气暗通，无需言语，便知进退攻守；道心历经惑幻、杀伐、慈悲多重磨砺，早已坚如磐石，不为外物虚妄所动。
一路西行，山川走势渐低，地势由崇岭丘壑，缓缓化为平野荒滩。草木由浓转疏，地气由阴转湿，风里带着浓重水汽，腥咸扑面，耳畔渐闻滔滔流水之声，浩荡不绝，隐隐如奔雷滚地。
张忠东驻足迎风，嗅着风中水汽，蹙眉言道：“前路水汽冲天，奔流浩荡，绝非寻常溪涧小河，必是大江巨川横亘前路。水势汹涌，风浪暗伏，恐有水底妖邪潜藏其间，兴风作浪，阻我西行去路。”
王学南垂眸掐指，卦爻流转，片刻面色沉凝，缓缓叹道：“卦象水势滔天，坎水临身，阴煞潜于深渊，有水族大妖盘踞流沙古渡一带。此河名曰忘川支流流沙河，河面宽阔百里，水深千丈，河底暗流交错，漩涡密布。古渡无人摆渡，舟船尽毁，往来行旅，皆被水底妖物拖入深渊，尸骨无存。”
宁洋北催动青木灵气，凌空漫探河面水脉。灵气入水，只觉河水之下，阴气沉沉，浊浪翻滚，河底藏着一股庞大妖力，暴戾凶狂，吞吐大水，搅动暗流，操控风浪，专覆行舟、吞噬路人。更有无数水族小妖盘踞河湾滩涂，巡守水域，不许生人靠近渡口半步。
他敛了灵气，正色言道：“流沙河阔水深，阻隔西行大道，欲往前路，必由此渡。水底妖邪凭水作乱，兴浪覆舟，残害生灵，阻塞通途。我等身负天命，不能绕行避祸，唯有直赴古渡，斩除水妖，平定狂澜，开通渡口，既济自身西行，亦救往后无数行旅。”
陈学西白虎利刃微鸣，眸光望向滔滔河面，寒芒隐现，沉声道：“水妖凭河自固，借水势逞凶，寻常法术难破水阵。不必多议，直赴古渡，一战荡平水族。”
四人遂整束行装，循着水声，直奔流沙河古渡而去。
渐行渐近，眼前景象豁然铺开。
一条大江横亘天地，河面浩渺无垠，浊浪滔滔，滚滚东奔；江面狂风呼啸，巨浪排空，白沫飞溅，声势骇人。两岸皆是黄沙荒滩，寸草难生，故名流沙河畔。滩上古渡残破，渡口石阶崩裂，朽舟断橹横卧沙滩，尽被风浪侵蚀，不见船夫，不见行旅，唯余满目荒凉，大水茫茫。
河水深处，暗流盘旋，大小漩涡不停翻涌，水下隐隐有黑影游弋，时隐时现，带着凶戾之气，窥视岸边。
四神立于渡口高滩，远眺茫茫江面，只见水天相连，烟波浩渺，风浪不息，整座大河如一头蛰伏巨兽，随时欲吞尽岸边生灵。
滩边尚有几名逃难百姓，蜷缩在破庙残垣之下，神色惶恐，望着滔滔河水，欲渡不敢，欲退无路。见四神气度不凡，身带灵光，连忙挣扎起身，跪倒叩首，哭声凄切。
“仙长救命！求仙长发发慈悲，渡我等过河！”
“流沙河古渡，已废数年，河底出了一头千年河豚大妖，兴风作浪，掀翻所有舟船，但凡有人想要渡河，皆被妖浪卷入水底，再无生还！”
“官府不敢设渡，船夫不敢行船，南北通路断绝，我们流落此地，进退两难，日日惶恐，生怕被水妖卷走，葬身鱼腹啊！”
老者泪流满面，伏地哀诉，字字悲怆。
“那河豚妖身躯庞大，隐于深潭之内，张口便能吸进滔滔河水，吐气便能掀起百丈狂浪；能召河中鱼虾精怪为麾下爪牙，遍布河湾浅滩，巡视水域。它性情暴戾，贪嗜生魂，每遇生人近岸，便兴风作浪，卷人入水，活活吞食。几年来，丧命河底者，数以千计，河滩白骨累累，皆为过往行旅遗骸。”
“我们已在此困守月余，前无去路，后有兵祸，只能守在破庙，听天由命，只求能有高人降妖，开通渡口，让我等得以渡河逃生。”

一众百姓叩首不止，额头沾沙，眼中满是绝望与期盼。
宁洋北连忙扶起众人，温声安抚：“乡亲莫惧，我等四人西行途经此地，已知水妖作祟，阻塞渡口，残害生灵。今日便在此降妖平浪，扫清水族妖孽，安稳河流水势，再造舟楫，渡尔等过河，不必再受困于此。”
百姓闻言，喜极而泣，连连拜谢，退至破庙深处，屏息等候，不敢惊扰。
张忠东望着汹涌江面，怒火暗生，沉声怒道：“区区水底鳞介之妖，也敢盘踞大江，称霸水域，覆舟杀人，阻塞大道！今日定要以朱雀烈火，烧得它河底无藏身之地，焚尽水族妖孽！”
王学南审慎言道：“此妖乃千年河豚精，生在深水寒潭，借河脉阴气修行，肉身肥厚坚韧，鳞甲滑腻，水火难侵；又精通水脉秘术，能引暗流、聚风浪、化水为兵、凝浪为山。更有无数虾兵蟹将、水蛇鱼精为其羽翼，盘踞整条流沙河，势力庞大，不可轻敌。且它居于深水潭底，借水势护身，我等在岸，它在水，地利在妖不在我，需谨慎布局，不可贸然涉水。”
宁洋北点头道：“所言极是。水妖倚水为势，我等若贸然入河，便落其圈套。可先立于渡口高地，以灵气引动天地清气，压制河中风浪；再以四方站位，布控水镇水之阵，锁其水脉，断其风浪；诱其出水，离深水巢穴，再合力围剿，便可破其依仗，一战斩之。”
陈学西冷然道：“妖不出水，便引它出水；妖若死守深渊，便以神力震彻河底，逼它现身。”
四人议定计策，不再迟疑，各自分立渡口四方高地，隐隐形成阵势。
宁洋东立东岸青滩，青木灵气弥漫，引大地生机，稳河岸地脉，令流沙不崩、滩涂不陷；
王学南立北岸石阶，玄武灵光沉凝，镇锁河底暗流，封印漩涡水道，断妖兴浪之源；
张忠南立南岸风口，朱雀圣火隐隐蓄势，待妖物现身，便以烈火焚水蒸浪，克制阴水妖气；
陈学西立西岸崩石，白虎杀气内敛，利刃在手，专待妖物露头，一击封喉，断其妖核。
四人站位既定，灵气同时运转，四道灵光冲天而起，隐与天地河脉相应。
宁洋北沉声开口，声传江面百里：“水底河豚妖！盘踞流沙河，兴浪覆舟，残害生灵，阻塞通途，罪孽滔天！即刻浮出水面，束手受缚，尚可留你一线残魂轮回；若冥顽不灵，死守深渊，我等便震裂河底，焚干水域，叫你水族尽数形神俱灭！”
声浪滚滚，覆过滔滔水声，响彻河面两岸。
河底沉寂片刻，唯有浊浪依旧翻滚，暗流愈发急促，隐隐透出一股暴怒凶戾之气。
忽闻河底传来一阵沉闷狂笑，似鼓雷闷响，震得河面水波震荡：“何方凡道小辈，敢在本座渡口叫嚣，妄言震裂河底、焚干水域？可笑可笑！此河乃本座修行道场，古渡乃本座敛食之地，生人到此，便是盘中吃食，轮得到尔等多管闲事？”
话音未落，河面中央骤然巨浪翻腾，百丈水浪拔地而起，冲天排空，狂风大作，黑云汇聚，原本浩荡的河水瞬间狂暴数倍。
content_en:
Farewell to the ghost market of Yinxu, breaking the illusion of the mountain spirit, the four gods left the barren valley and headed west again.
Since his descent into the mortal world, he has gone through five tribulations: cutting bones, praying for sweet rain, slaying snake demons, saving sheep demons, and destroying ghost markets. Ningyang Beiqinglong is full of vitality, Wang Xuenan's Xuanwu guard is steady, Zhang Zhongdong's Suzaku is fierce and fierce, and Chen Xuexi's white tiger is killing and fierce. The divine power of the four elephants is becoming more and more intertwined. During the journey, the spiritual energy is secretly connected, and you can advance, retreat, attack and defend without any words. The Taoist heart has been tempered by delusions, killings, and compassion, and it has long been as solid as a rock, unmoved by the illusions of external objects.
Along the way westward, the mountains and rivers gradually become lower and lower, and the terrain gradually changes from mountains and hills to plains and deserted beaches. The vegetation changes from dense to sparse, the earth's atmosphere changes from cloudy to wet, the wind carries heavy water vapor, smelling fishy and salty, and gradually the sound of rushing water can be heard in the ears, which is endless and faint, like thunder rolling on the ground.
Zhang Zhongdong stopped to face the wind, sniffing the water vapor in the wind, frowning and saying: "The water vapor on the road ahead is soaring into the sky, and the flow is mighty. It is by no means an ordinary stream. It must be a huge river and a huge river crossing the road ahead. The water is turbulent, the wind and waves are hidden, and there may be underwater monsters lurking in it, making waves and blocking my way westward."
Wang Xuenan lowered his eyes and pinched his fingers, the hexagram lines were flowing, his face became calm for a moment, and he sighed slowly: "The hexagram symbolizes the surging water, the impending water is coming, the evil spirits are lurking in the abyss, and there is a big demon of the water tribe entrenched in the Liusha Ancient Crossing area. The name of this river is Wang. The Liusha River, a tributary of the Sichuan River, is hundreds of miles wide and thousands of feet deep. The bottom of the river is crisscrossed with undercurrents and densely covered with whirlpools. No one has ferried across the ancient ferry. All the boats and ships that traveled there were dragged into the abyss by underwater monsters, and no bones were left. "
Ning Yangbei mobilized the aura of green wood and explored the water veins of the river in the air. When the spiritual energy enters the water, I feel that under the river, there is a gloomy air, and the turbid waves are rolling. There is a huge demon power hidden at the bottom of the river. It is violent and ferocious. It swallows large amounts of water, stirs up the undercurrent, controls the wind and waves, capsizes boats, and swallows passers-by. There are also countless water tribe little monsters occupying the tidal flats of the river bends, patrolling the waters, and no strangers are allowed to get even half a step closer to the ferry.
He collected his spiritual energy and spoke sternly: "The Liusha River is wide and deep, blocking the westbound road. If you want to go forward, you must cross here. The monsters in the water make trouble with the water, make waves and capsize boats, harm living creatures, and block the road. We have a destiny and cannot go around to avoid disasters. We can only go straight to the ancient ferry to kill the water monsters, calm the waves, and open the ferry. This will not only help ourselves to travel westward, but also save countless travelers in the future."
Chen Xuexi's white tiger blade chirped slightly, his eyes looked at the surging river, a cold light appeared, and he said in a deep voice: "The water demon relies on the river to stabilize itself, and uses the water's power to do its evil. It is difficult for ordinary magic to break through the water formation. Without further discussion, go straight to the ancient ferry and defeat the water tribe in one battle."
The four of them packed up their gear and headed straight for the ancient ferry of Liusha River, following the sound of water.
As we got closer, the scene before our eyes suddenly unfolded.
A big river stretches across the sky and the earth. The river is vast, and the turbid waves are rolling eastward. The wind is howling on the river, the huge waves are emptying, and the white foam is splashing. The sound is terrifying. Both sides of the river are covered with yellow sand and barren beaches, where no grass can grow, hence the name Liusha River. The ancient ferry on the beach is broken, the stone steps of the ferry are broken, and the rotten boat and broken oars are lying on the beach, all eroded by the wind and waves. There are no boatmen and no travelers, only desolation and vast water are left.
In the depths of the river, undercurrents swirled, large and small whirlpools kept tumbling, and dark shadows swam faintly under the water, appearing and disappearing, peering at the shore with a menacing aura.
The four gods stood on the high beach of the ferry, looking out over the vast river. They saw water and sky connected, vast mist, and endless wind and waves. The entire river was like a dormant giant beast, ready to swallow up all life on the bank at any time.
There are still a few fleeing people on the beach, huddled under the ruins of the ruined temple, looking frightened, looking at the surging river, not wanting to cross, and wanting to retreat with no way out. Seeing that the four gods were extraordinary and possessed of aura, they quickly struggled to their feet, knelt down and knelt, crying sadly.
"Immortal, help me! Please have mercy on me and help us cross the river!"
"The ancient ferry on the Liusha River has been abandoned for several years. A thousand-year-old puffer fish monster appeared from the bottom of the river. It made waves and capsized all the boats. Anyone who tried to cross the river was swept under the water by the monster waves and no one survived!"
"The government did not dare to set up a ferry, and the boatmen did not dare to sail. The north and southThe access road is cut off, and we are trapped here. We are in a dilemma, and we are in fear every day. We are afraid that we will be swept away by the water monster and buried in the belly of the fish! "
The old man burst into tears, fell to the ground and complained, every word of which was sad.
"The puffer fish monster has a huge body and hides in the deep pool. It can suck in the surging river water when it opens its mouth, and it can set off hundreds of meters of wild waves when it exhales. It can summon the fish and shrimp spirits in the river as its minions, all over the river bends and shoals, patrolling the waters. It has a violent temperament and is greedy for life. Whenever it encounters a stranger near the shore, it will make waves, drag people into the water, and devour them alive. In the past few years, thousands of people have died at the bottom of the river, and the riverbank is littered with bones, all the remains of past travellers. "
"We have been trapped here for more than a month, with no way out, and there is a war in the future. We can only stay in the ruined temple and resign ourselves to fate. We can only hope that someone can master the demon and open the ferry so that we can cross the river and escape. "
All the people kowtowed, their foreheads were stained with sand, and their eyes were full of despair and expectation.
Ning Yangbei hurriedly helped everyone up and comforted them with a gentle voice: "Don't be afraid, folks. The four of us and I are passing through this place on our westward journey. It is known that water monsters are causing trouble, blocking the ferry and killing people. Today we will slay the demons and calm the waves here, clear away the water monsters, stabilize the water flow of the river, rebuild the boat, and cross the river without being trapped here anymore. "
When the people heard this, they cried with joy, thanked him repeatedly, and retreated to the depths of the ruined temple. They waited with bated breath and did not dare to disturb him.
Zhang Zhongdong looked at the turbulent river, with secret anger, and said angrily in a deep voice: "A mere scaly monster under the water dares to occupy the river, dominate the water, capsize boats, kill people, and block the highway! Today, I will use the fierce fire of Suzaku to burn it until there is no hiding place at the bottom of the river, and burn all the monsters of the water tribe! "
Wang Xuenan said cautiously: "This demon is a thousand-year-old puffer fish spirit. It was born in the cold deep water pool. It uses the yin energy of the river to practice cultivation. Its flesh is thick and tough, its scales are slippery, and it is difficult for water and fire to invade. It is also proficient in the secret technique of water veins. It can induce undercurrents, gather wind and waves, turn water into soldiers, and condense waves into mountains." There are also countless shrimp soldiers, crab generals, water snakes and fish spirits as their wings, occupying the entire Liusha River. Their power is huge and cannot be underestimated. Moreover, it lives at the bottom of a deep pool, using the force of the water to protect itself. We are waiting on the shore, while it is in the water. The location is good for the monster but not for me. We need to be careful in our layout and do not rush into the water. "
Ning Yangbei nodded and said, "What you said is absolutely true. The water demon relies on the water for its power. If we enter the river rashly, we will fall into its trap. You can first stand on the high ground at the ferry, use spiritual energy to induce the clear air of heaven and earth, and suppress the wind and waves in the river; then stand in all directions, deploy a water-control array, lock the water veins, and cut off the wind and waves; lure it out of the water, away from the deep water nest, and then join forces to encircle and suppress it, you can break its support and kill it in one battle. "
Chen Xuexi said coldly: "If the demon cannot come out of the water, we will lure it out of the water; if the demon clings to the abyss, we will use divine power to shake the bottom of the river and force it to emerge. "
The four people agreed on a strategy and without any further hesitation, they separated themselves from the high ground around the ferry and formed a faint formation.
Ningyang East stands on the green beach on the east bank. The aura of green trees permeates the earth, bringing vitality to the earth and stabilizing the veins of the river bank, preventing quicksands from collapsing and tidal flats from sinking;
Wang Xuenan set up the stone steps on the north bank, and the basalt aura condensed to suppress the undercurrent at the bottom of the river, seal the whirlpool waterway, and cut off the source of demons and waves;
Zhang Zhongnan set up the wind outlet on the south bank, and the sacred fire of the red bird was gathering momentum. When the monster appeared, he would use the fire to burn the water and evaporate the waves to restrain the evil spirit of the yin water;
When Chen Xuexi stood on the west bank of the collapsed rocks, the white tiger restrained his murderous intent and held the sharp blade in his hand, waiting for the monster to show its head, sealing its throat with one blow and cutting off its monster core.
The four people stood in a certain position, and their spiritual energy circulated at the same time. Four spiritual lights rose into the sky, corresponding to the rivers of heaven and earth.
Ning Yangbei spoke in a deep voice, and his voice spread hundreds of miles across the river: "Underwater puffer fish monster! Occupying the Liusha River, making waves and overturning boats, harming living beings, blocking access, and committing heinous crimes! Immediately surface, with your hands tied, you can still have a remnant of your soul to reincarnate; if you are stubborn and cling to the abyss, we will crack the bottom of the river, burn the water dry, and destroy all your aquatic species in body and spirit! "
The sound waves rolled over the sound of the rushing water and resounded on both sides of the river.
The bottom of the river was silent for a moment, only the turbid waves were still rolling, the undercurrent became more rapid, and there was a faint hint of anger and ferociousness.
Suddenly I heard a dull laughter coming from the bottom of the river, as ifThe sound of drums and thunder made the water on the river tremble: "How dare you, a mortal Taoist, to shout at my ferry and make false claims of cracking the bottom of the river and burning the water dry? It's ridiculous! This river is my practice place, and the ancient ferry is my place to gather food. When strangers come here, they just eat from the plate. Is it your turn to meddle in other people's business?"
Before he finished speaking, huge waves suddenly rolled in the middle of the river. Waves of water hundreds of feet rose up from the ground, reaching the sky. Strong winds blew, black clouds gathered, and the originally mighty river suddenly became violent several times.
